review.use_summary: Used Monocle3 1.0.0 on the reported UMAT embedding to reconstruct lineage trajectories and select shortest paths; a modified graph_test with covariates identified trajectory-associated genes.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper reports UMAT, gene/cell filtering, selected paths and a modified covariate-aware Moran test. Do not silently rename the embedding, infer the custom implementation or equate stock graph_test with its sex/batch/PMI/log_n_genes-adjusted version. The native component handles only supplied projected-graph ordering; graph learning, the modified test, metacell smoothing, spline models and clustering remain separate workflow requirements.

review.use_summary: Compared pseudotime from py-monocle, described in the paper as a Monocle 3 Python wrapper, with neural-network predictions and Palantir in microglia; tried 200 eligible starting cells and retained the highest Braak-stage correlation.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper calls this a Python wrapper; upstream describes a separate Python implementation with graph-handling changes. Exact paper commit and settings are unstated. The inspected Community-Use License permits noncommercial use only. No runtime installation or analysis has run; implementation awaits the user license preference. R/native Monocle controls are not py-monocle controls. Preserve specified starting-cell eligibility and selection; these are not default root selection or independent predictive validation.

review.use_summary: Used Cicero for Monocle 3 to infer cis-co-accessible cCRE pairs per cell subclass, using mm10, default Cicero parameters and 500 kb genomic windows.
review.implementation_scope_note: This paragraph identifies Monocle as the platform for Cicero and does not establish a Monocle trajectory/pseudotime run. Cicero, shuffled-background fitting, FDR filtering and distal/proximal annotation are distinct analyses. Exact Monocle/Cicero patches and author-specific preparation remain unresolved; do not credit them to the native pseudotime component or a stock Monocle trajectory adapter. Preserve the reported failed Hypendymal_NN subclass and the source filtering wording without reversing its meaning.

review.use_summary: Applied the Monocle3 pipeline with Batchelor 1.20.0 integration, Monocle3 1.3.7 dimensional reduction/clustering and pseudotime; a separate Wilcoxon test compared immature control and Tgfbr2-mutant cells.
review.implementation_scope_note: The complete paragraph explicitly reports Monocle3 1.3.7, correcting the unreviewed missing-version extraction. Exact preprocessing, integration settings, graph controls, roots and transformations are unstated. The separate Wilcoxon test used continuity correction. The current 1.4.27 readiness profile and native prepared-graph component do not establish historical 1.3.7/Batchelor parity or that complete experiment. Official DESCRIPTION history now supplies a version-matching source candidate; the paper commit is not established and source capture does not validate execution.

review.use_summary: Used monocle3 1.3.1 fit_models GLMs to relate spatial gene expression to amyloid Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot scores, adjusting for biological sample and UMI count; followed significant Wald-test results with positive Pearson-correlation filtering.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is gene-wise GLM inference, not Monocle pseudotime. The model family, exact formula/encoding, normalization and full testing family are unstated. Human grey-matter filtering, mouse regional fits, separate stains and subsequent Pearson filtering remain explicit upstream/downstream steps. The attempted original 1.3.1 runtime is skipped because grr does not compile under R 4.6.1; a current 1.4.27 synthetic quasipoisson probe is not a silent version/family substitution.

review.use_summary: Used Monocle 2 differentialGeneTest for gene/exon and accessibility comparisons, age/AD analyses with sex covariates, subtype fraction likelihood-ratio tests, and human AD/control expression comparisons; populations and significance/effect/expression filters differ by analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: Named supporting Methods identify subclusters, exon inputs, maximum-5000 sampling, sex covariates, RT-well or mouse replicate counts, accessibility filters and human comparisons. Exact patch, family, full formulas and normalization remain unresolved. The validated 2.26.0 development adapter preserves original differential tests, size factors and dispersions, without reconstructing unstated choices or the paper patch. Original free-NB/binomial family failures remain unadmitted. TPM thresholds do not establish raw-count eligibility; do not treat cells as mouse replicates, drop failed genes or substitute Monocle3 tests.

review.use_summary: Predicted cis-co-accessible cCRE pairs separately across 275 subclasses with Cicero for Monocle3, mm10, 500-kb windows and default parameters, followed by shuffled-background score fitting and FDR filtering.
review.implementation_scope_note: Samples at most 5000 nuclei per subclass; the paper reports the Hypendymal_NN subclass failed. Normal background fitting uses fitdistrplus, BH FDR<0.001 and GENCODE mm10v23 TSS±1kb distal/proximal grouping. The source says filtered out only if scores were significantly larger; preserve that wording rather than infer a reversed retention rule. Exact Cicero/Monocle commits, seeds and background implementation remain unknown. Source capture of Cicero-M3 1.3.9 is not paper reproduction.
